en: Many believe Jose Rizal was the first president, but Emilio Aguinaldo was officially the first president of the Philippine republic.
Contrary to popular belief, the eight rays of the Philippine sun represent the first eight provinces that revolted against Spain, not eight islands.
Unlike some countries, the Philippine Constitution limits the President to a single six-year term, strictly prohibiting any reelection.
People often think Tagalog is the only official language, but the 1987 Constitution declares both Filipino and English as official languages.
The Senate and House of Representatives belong to the Legislative branch that makes laws, not the Executive branch that enforces them.
Although the Waling-waling is famous, the Sampaguita was officially declared the national flower of the Philippines in 1934.
It is a common myth that Spain ruled the Philippines for exactly 300 years, when actual colonization lasted 333 years.
Jose Rizal did not lead an armed rebellion, but instead fought for reforms peacefully using his novels Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo.
The 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution was a peaceful four-day civilian protest, not a violent month-long military war.
Andres Bonifacio, not Jose Rizal, founded the Katipunan to secure Philippine independence through a revolutionary armed struggle.
The Igorot people are not a single unified tribe, but a collective term for several distinct ethnolinguistic groups in the Cordilleras.
The Supreme Court is the highest tribunal of the Judicial branch, completely independent from the President who leads the Executive branch.
